metadata.coverage_note: Evergreen markers are facilities with at least one parsed report above 35 red points. Marker status is based on the latest scraper-observed current status, parsed follow-up PDF fields, and later inspections for the same facility. Blank TPCHD grade fields are shown as no grade shown by TPCHD, not as zero.
metadata.data_universe: Scraper-observed TPCHD Accela food-facility inspection records with parsed PDF reports; this public evergreen layer includes facilities with at least one record over the red-point threshold.
metadata.freshness_note: Generated from the latest TPCHD scraper/publication run.
metadata.map_cannot_show: This map does not show neighborhood-level health risk, all below-threshold facilities, or rows without reviewed coordinates.
metadata.map_claim: Shows geocoded public restaurant facilities with at least one parsed inspection above 35 red points, with current TPCHD status and later observed inspection context where available.

privacy.review: Exact restaurant locations are public commercial facility addresses from public inspection records.

metadata.source_note: Tacoma-Pierce County Health Department Accela food-facility inspection pages and parsed inspection-report PDFs.

symbology.note: Evergreen markers use current/actionable TPCHD status as the primary color/letter encoding. Historical red-point severity is shown in popups and filters. Alert/run maps use fixed red-point classes with darker red for higher totals.

metadata.title: Tacoma-Pierce County restaurant inspections with more than 35 red points
